name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: France blames IRGC unit for store hacks (9 Nov)
summary: France attributed October cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration to an Iranian Revolutionary Guards unit on 9 Nov
state: On 9 Nov France attributed attacks on supermarket refrigeration systems on 11–12 Oct to a cyber unit of Iran's Revolutionary Guards; hundreds of stores were hit, millions of euros of food spoiled and similar spikes were seen in five other European countries on 2 Nov (Al Jazeera; France 24). Paris prosecutors sought arrest warrants and France summoned Iran's ambassador. No casualties or major outage were reported, so the Alert line is not crossed.
for_you: Retailers and operators of internet-connected building systems are most exposed. Organisations should follow NCSC guidance on securing operational technology.
rubric_hit: Sabotage attributed to a state (Iran, by France on 9 Nov); no casualties or major outage
